assumptions.statement: Official site and key-area polygons are unavailable; submitted geometry is provisional and low-confidence.
assumptions.impact: All spatial metrics and figures require recalculation when official geometry arrives.

assumptions.statement: No real workplace, employment relation, sensor installation or worker population is identified.
assumptions.impact: Spatial components remain empty-site conceptual kits.
assumptions.review_trigger: field, title, fire, heritage and accessibility review

assumptions.statement: Anti-retaliation, compensation, consent and withdrawal language is a design requirement, not a legal conclusion.
assumptions.impact: No live trial before applicable labour and organisational procedure is confirmed.

assumptions.statement: Derived files, models and interfaces may not be technically deletable in every supply chain.
assumptions.impact: Unlocatable disputed derivatives remain disabled; deletion is never claimed without evidence.

assumptions.statement: Two-track space may expose or stigmatise refusal.
assumptions.impact: Choice must remain private and both routes must reach equal facilities.
